criteria.question: Is the patient's latest BMI between 30.0 and 44.9 kg/m2?
criteria.original_text: Body Mass Index (BMI) ≥30.0 kg/m^2 to <45.0 kg/m^2 at screening

criteria.question: Is the patient's latest BMI ≥27.0 kg/m2 with hypertension, dyslipidemia, prediabetes, OSA, CAD, heart failure, or cerebrovascular disease?
criteria.original_text: BMI ≥27.0 kg/m^2 at screening with at least 1 of the following weight-related co-morbidities: Hypertension, Dyslipidemia, Prediabetes, established Obstructive Sleep Apnea (OSA), established Coronary Artery Disease (CAD), Heart failure, established cerebrovascular disease as described in the protocol

criteria.question: Does the patient have a diagnosis of Type 1 or Type 2 diabetes?
criteria.original_text: Previous or current diagnosis of Type 1 or Type 2 diabetes at screening

criteria.question: Did the patient have a change in body weight >5 kg in the last 3 months?
criteria.original_text: Change in body weight >5 kg within approximately 3 months before screening as described in the protocol

criteria.question: Does the patient have a history of bariatric surgery or related revision procedures?
criteria.original_text: Bariatric surgery, including any procedures to revise, reverse, or remove any previous bariatric surgery interventions as described in the protocol

criteria.question: Does the patient have a history of acute or chronic pancreatitis, cholecystitis, or symptomatic gallbladder stones?
criteria.original_text: History of acute or chronic pancreatitis, cholecystitis, or symptomatic gallbladder stones

criteria.question: Does the patient or their family have a history of medullary thyroid carcinoma or multiple endocrine neoplasia type 2?
criteria.original_text: History or family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma or multiple endocrine neoplasia type 2

criteria.question: Do other protocol-defined exclusion criteria apply?
criteria.original_text: Note: Other Protocol Defined Inclusion/ Exclusion Criteria Apply
